en.topic_title: Chinese woman accused of spying on Nvidia boss entered Taiwan on Hong Kong passport
en.topic_summary:
The woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Nvidia chief Jensen Huang used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan, the island’s immigration agency said Wednesday, as authorities investigate the incident.



This screengrab from video footage by CTI shows Alice Huang (2nd R in pink) attending a dinner hosted by Nvidia’s chief executive and co-founder Jensen Huang (2nd L in black back facing camera) at a restaurant in Taipei on May 22, 2025. Photo: AFP.
